bullets.content: [general] Before any tool call copy THIS task's LIMITS line verbatim ('at most 4 solves' on both tasks; big wrote 16 three generations running, used 6). Write 'solve budget = 4'. Plan: S1 control, S2 judge, S3/S4 single-factor variants, then submit(argmax est. score). A 5th solve is a violation. quality.min>=0.1.

[general] Run one controlled change per solve and state it. big's S4 changed three things at once (unattributable); S5->S6 single change gave a clean answer. With 4 solves spend one on a judge only if a safe control is already solved.

[general] Write a ranking table (solve, DOFs, diff, est. e, est. score) and submit argmax via submit(solve=k), never the last solve by default (big: S5 est 0.240 but S6 went in; on bc0 submitted S4 0.502 while S1/S3 ~0.6).

[general] Calibrate compare(): true error ~1.2-1.25x diff to a judge with ~2x DOFs (bc0 9.27 vs 7.42; bc7 1.16-1.20). Use sqrt(diff^2+e_judge^2) only if judge error is estimated. Choose by estimated score, not DOFs: a cheap mesh above target can lose.

[general] Judge recipe: compare(S1,judge), compare(S2,judge); error ~ calibration x diff (1.2-1.3) or sqrt(diff^2+e_judge^2). Rank by A/c, A=(g/2)^2 if g<2 else g/2, e=max(field, point estimate); submit argmax, not necessarily the finest. Big's estimate matched true error.
[general] Rank candidates by energy deficit: fit U_ref from your finest solves (or Richardson e~N^-2/3), error ~ sqrt(1-U/U_ref). Predicted 11.0% vs true 10.5%; ZZ reads 1.2-1.4x low.

[general] Above target score=g/(2c): refinement pays only if local rate p=ln(e1/e2)/ln(N2/N1)>1, coarsening only if p<1. Below target A=(g/2)^2. When p<0.67 in 3D order 2, extra DOFs lower score: submit the argmax, not the finest (big's S4 0.2315 beat finer S5/S6 ~0.225).

[general] Strain energy ranks candidates for free (bc0: S3<S4<S1<S2 matched compare). A variant with more nodes but lower energy than control signals noise or a misplaced refinement: discard it. Never submit lowest-energy unless DOF saving beats break-even.

[general] Name the binding term (field vs check-point RMS) before choosing. If a refinement doesn't touch where check points sit, it can't lower the point term; stop refining a region once its field error is below the point RMS. Where points bind, use hotspot local vM errors in smooth regions.

[general] Call view(kind=error) after EVERY solve (big viewed once in 6). Compare each top hotspot's local h with the request; if >1.3-1.5x or outside the refinement radius, move/enlarge it (root hotspots 0.0028-0.0031 vs 0.0021 requested). Box bounds must enclose hotspot coords +~3 mm.
[general] Call compare(control, variant) for every candidate before submit (big called it 0 times; energy increments can't show mid-height changes). Check reaction vs true load resultant.
[general] After each compare(), list top-3 regions with nearest edge and distance. Any edge within 3 mm holding >3% gets an {edge} refinement with radius = distance + 2-3 mm.

[general] Score economics in 3D order 2: e~N^-2/3, so score rises as c^(1/3) below target and falls as c^(-1/3) above. Submit the cheapest mesh near the target error; avoid global refinement once met. Beyond that, move DOFs from low-error to high-error regions.

[general] Read node count from mesh(). If a refinement changes nodes <2-3% (big's bc0 S4 box 0.0035 added 35 nodes), it realised nothing: request ~0.7x desired size or drop it before spending a solve.

[general] Peer big's recipe: coarse background plus nested boxes over the previous run's hotspot pocket (box spans hotspot x/y +3 mm, size ~0.6x their local h) cut DOFs 32% with no accuracy loss, score 0.42->0.63.
[general] Closed bores under pressure self-balance (|R|~0 N). Open faces: reaction = p x projected area. Don't chase phantom errors.

[general] Boxes can't follow annular bands: tile ring with 4 side-strip boxes (inner edge r_in-1mm, outer r_out+1mm, radius 0.002; cut add-on +19.4k to +6.2k DOFs), or refine the single CAD edge the band hugs. Never box a whole disk that is black on the error map.

[general] Boxes realise ~1.2-1.35x requested size. For a target h at a clamp rim use {edge:tag}, or request 0.75x in a THIN slab, never a deep box. Edge radius must exceed hotspot offset +3-4 mm. Read per-group h in mesh().

[general] Edge refinements along singular lines (re-entrant, clamp rims) beat volume boxes over solid regions: big cut DOFs 32.2k->19.7k and scored best (0.231). Leave black-on-error-map regions at background h.

[general] On thin walls (wall ~ background h), edge refinements reach only ~their radius. Hotspots offset >radius need a box spanning the band ±3 mm. Pair edges (curve singularity) with one band box (bending zone).
[general] For open loaded faces (bc0: f7) check once that the f12 reaction equals the applied pressure resultant (non-zero). Mismatch means a setup error, showing as error spread over the whole part.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Setup correct, reuse verbatim: 3d, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3, fixed f2, pressure 4.0e6 on f23 and 2.1e6 on f16 (into part), no gravity. Closed bores: f2 reaction ~0 N.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Next variant: control + {edge:40,0.0022,r0.004}, or ring strips z 0.052-0.0585 (inner r0.0137, outer r0.018, size 0.0026, r0.0015; not on cap f25). Clamp band holds ~16% error, hotspots #1/#6 1.6-2 mm from edge 40 at h 0.0041-0.0043. Expect diff -0.5 to -1 point for ~+1.5k DOFs.

[abc_00000003_bc7] AVOID tightening {group f2} to 0.002 r0.006 (+1.9k DOFs, diff 14.6->14.4%): a group refinement stays on the face and misses wall hotspots 1.5-3 mm below. Never full-height clamp boxes (32k DOFs); never drop f2 refinement (f2 h 0.00486, field 16.4->18.4%).

[abc_00000003_bc7] Never drop the belt box (without it hotspots h 0.0051-0.0054, diff 15.0->16.9%). Do NOT grow it beyond z 0.0165-0.032: down to 0.011 +1.8k DOFs diff 14.0->13.7% (0.225); up to 0.0345 diff 13.9% (0.224). If DOFs free up, test size 0.0029 in the same bounds.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Low priority: upper stub flank z 0.032-0.040 near y -0.013 (2.65% at h 0.0044). Only if DOFs free up try edges 8/39 radius 0.006 instead of 0.005; don't extend the box over it.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Ablation record: dropping belt box saved 3.9k DOFs but diff +1.9 points (worth it). Spend at most one ablation per refinement; log diff change per 1k DOFs.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Thresholds vs 0.2315 control: target 15.93% needs diff <=~13.3% (calibration 1.2). Field binds (16.8% vs points 6.3%). Rate p~0.45: only placement pays. Order-2 recipes flat at 0.22-0.233 for three generations.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Coarsen only black areas: stub ends f15,f17, cap f25, bottom wall z<0.012 stay at background 0.006. h>=0.009 fails quality. Spend DOFs within 4 mm of edge 40 and the intersection curves (edges 8/39).
[abc_00000003_bc7] Thin wall sets DOFs: keep background h 0.006. h 0.007 saved 8% nodes but diff 15.1%->17.0%, quality 0.157; 0.0075 gave ~21%.
[abc_00000003_bc7] AVOID splitting belt box into two side boxes |x| 0.0155-0.0225: diff 12.6%->16.1%. Belt centre (|x|<0.0155 near f12/f20) holds hotspots; keep refined.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Boxes realise h ~1.2-1.35x requested (0.0032->0.0044). Request ~0.75x desired or use edges; read per-group h in mesh().

[abc_00000003_bc7] Diversity (one solve, untested): order 3, h 0.008, {group f2,0.004,r0.005}, {edge 8,0.004,r0.005}, {edge 39,0.004,r0.005}, {edge 40,0.0035,r0.004}, belt box 0.0045. DOFs<=24k, quality>=0.1. If mesh() rejects order 3, note it.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Wall ~2.5 mm thick (radii ~14.7, 17.2 mm). Two quadratic elements across (h 0.00125) cost ~100k DOFs: unaffordable. Spend extra DOFs only at clamp rim, stub intersections.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Judge (53.5k DOFs): h 0.0032, order 2, {edge 40,0.0014,r0.006}, {edge 39,0.0016,r0.005}, {edge 8,0.0016,r0.005}, {edge 3,0.0018,r0.004}. Calibration now 1.20 (S4 16.8/14.0; earlier 1.16). e=1.2 x diff; score=(0.3186/e/2)^2/(DOFs/6057). Order: control, judge, 2 variants.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Field error binds (16.8% vs points 6.3%). Worst points are low-stress outer-wall spots near stubs (~10% off); don't chase them, only clamp-band and belt field error moves the score.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Setup verified: 3d, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3, fixed f12, pressure 2.1e6 into f7, no gravity. f7 open: f12 reaction non-zero (p x projected area); check once.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Next (one solve): narrow root box to [0.016,-0.010,-0.0085,0.029,0.010,-0.0055] 0.0018 r0.002, covering hotspots #1-#5 (x 18.5-26.6 mm, z -6.6 to -7.4, realised h 0.0028-0.0031; ~39% of error). Keep only if 1.25 x diff gives higher g/(2c).
